title: Isocyanate-group-containing crosslinkers for nitrile rubber
abstract: By using special crosslinkers which contain at least two isocyanate groups, it is possible to successfully crosslink optionally hydrogenated nitrile rubber terpolymers which contain hydroxyl groups. Preferred cross-linking agents have the following structural elements: allophanates, biurets, uretdiones, uretonimines, bridged urethanes, carbodiimides, isocyanurates, iminooxadiazinediones, or oxadiazinetriones.
